adaptations: The Thaumaturge modular focus tiers replace removed Thaumcraft excavation/frost/primal/portable-hole component items in the original infusion recipes; original instability and aspect costs are retained and retired aspects are merged through the parent mapping.
The 117-slot bottomless pouch uses three vanilla chest pages (54 + 54 + 9); sneak-use cycles pages. The custom 1.7 scrolling screen is replaced.
Gate destinations retain 10 stored pearls, same-dimension validation, arrival locking and pearl drops. Direct server-authoritative hand interactions replace the two old gateway GUI screens.
Old Baubles slots map to Curios necklace, belt and ring tags. Armor effects toggle per stack by sneak-use; no U-key dependency.
Soul hearts use Minecraft absorption with a 20-point maximum so damage consumption and HUD sync are handled by the game.

The bedrock dimension retains the 256-high solid bedrock mass, a weighted ore type per column, and 200 vein attempts. Ore Dictionary categories map to c:ores/<material> tags; only installed categories participate. Vein geometry uses bounded random walks instead of the removed WorldGenMinable.

Armor uses the native armor rendering pipeline with original robe and awakened textures and original armor points (3/8/6/3), enchantability 20, and no toughness. Custom animated wings and the mirror placement ghost are not yet rendered.

Legacy metadata dependencies resolve to arcane bore, lamp of growth, travel paving stone, tainted goo and native cinnabar/iron/gold clusters. Original potion components accept a potion item without a required effect.

en_us.research.thaumictinkerer.ichor_cap.title: Ichorium Wand Caps
en_us.research.thaumictinkerer.ichor_cap.text: You have put Ichorium to its first ever use, by devising wand caps that give you a 20% discount on everything. Now you need to actually put this to any use and create a wand that can store more vis.
You have done it. By infusing a silverwood wand core with Ichorcloth, you managed to create the ultimate wand core.

This core holds an insane amount of 1000 of each type of vis. This will definitely make crafting expensive components a bit less stressful. Now the question lies, where will you get all the vis for this?
en_us.research.thaumictinkerer.ichorcloth_armo:
You have found how to weave Ichorcloth into clothing.

These new clothes are about as effective as mundane diamond armor, when it comes to protecting the wearer from damage. However, this cloth is completely unbreakable and will never sustain as much as a scratch.
You found a way of upgrading the Ichorcloth Cowl into a more powerful form.

First and foremost, the cowl doubles as goggles of revealing.
Second, the wearer is granted unlimited underwater breath as well as crystal clear underwater vision.
Lastly, if one wearing this cowl finds themselves without a full belly, the effects of health restoration will still apply, as if that was the case. Sneak-use the item to toggle its effects.
en_us.research.thaumictinkerer.ichor_chest_gem:
You found a way of upgrading the Ichorcloth Robes into a more powerful form.

Starting off, by simply wearing these robes, the wearer is blessed with the power of eternal flight (wings that don't burn after 5 minutes included), as well as having all fall damage negated.
The robes also passively protect the wearer from any incoming simple projectiles, akin to the focus of Distortion. Sneak-use the item to toggle its effects.
You found a way of upgrading the Ichorcloth Leggings into a more powerful form.

These leggings are infused with the soul of fire.
For one, they cast a light around the holder, brighter even than that of Hyperenergetic Nitor. This light also expands to where the wearer is looking, akin to a flashlight, and prevails given the creator's existence in a much extended range.
Furthermore, these leggings not only provide fire resistance, but they convert any incoming fire damage into healing. Sneak-use the item to toggle its effects.
en_us.research.thaumictinkerer.ichor_boots_gem:
You found a way of upgrading the Ichorcloth Boots into a more powerful form.

These boots allow for extremely smooth movement, akin to the Boots of the Traveller. The wearer's speed, jump height and jump reach all become magnified by wearing the boots, making movement a breeze. One can also walk on 1 high blocks as if they are slabs, this can be suppressed by sneaking.
Wearing the boots also induces a constant Haste II effect, turns any dirt below them into grass and negates all fall damage. Sneak-use the item to toggle its effects.
en_us.research.thaumictinkerer.ichor_tools.tex:
You discovered how to create tools out of Ichorium. These tools are extremely powerful, even more so than diamond, furthermore, they never break.

For the creation of these tools, mundane sticks aren't enough, you decided to use Silverwood rods in replacement.
You awakened the real potential of an Ichorium Pickaxe. This pickaxe contains all the traits from the regular one, however, by shift right clicking on it, you can change what mode it's on.

On Block Mode (Green) it'll break blocks normally.

On Square Mode (Red) it'll break a 5x5 area around the original block broken. The area is offset, to allow for easy mining

On Line Mode (Blue)
en_us.research.thaumictinkerer.ichor_shovel_ge:
You awakened the real potential of an Ichorium Shovel. This shovel contains all the traits from the regular one, however, by shift right clicking on it, you can change what mode it's on.

On Block Mode (Green) it'll break blocks normally.

On Square Mode (Red) it'll break a 5x5 area around the original block broken.

On Column Mode (Blue) it'll break a column of the same type of block as the one originally broken, 8 blocks above and below.
en_us.research.thaumictinkerer.ichor_axe_gem.t:
You awakened the real potential of an Ichorium Axe. This axe contains all the traits from the regular one, however, by shift right clicking on it, you can change what mode it's on.

On Block Mode (Green) it'll break blocks normally.

On Square Mode (Red) it'll break a 5x5 area around the original block broken.

On Tree Mode (Blue) it'll break entire trees by simply cutting down one of their blocks.

This axe is also extremely proficient at cutting plant life.
en_us.research.thaumictinkerer.ichor_sword_gem:
You awakened the real potential of an Ichorium Sword. This sword contains all the traits from the regular one, however, by shift right clicking on it, you can change what mode it's on.

On Single Mode (Green) it'll attack mobs normally.

On Area Mode (Red) it'll attack all mobs of the same type in a 3 block radius of the attacked one.

On Soul Mode (Blue) it'll deal less damage than normally, but every hit will bless the attacker with a Soul Heart.
[continued]
en_us.research.thaumictinkerer.cat_amulet.text:
It didn't take you long to come to the conclusion that you hated all those times a creeper snuck up on you.

To that end, using the knowledge you have that creepers run away from cats, you have devised an amulet that by simply being carried on you makes all creepers run in fear of your presence. Not only that, but they'll be petrified to the point of not gathering enough stoke to explode. Great. It must be worn in your amulet slot to take effect.
en_us.research.thaumictinkerer.ichor_pouch.tex: A 117-slot pouch that accepts ordinary items and prevents nested pouches. Use to open the current page; sneak-use to cycle between pages 1, 2 and 3 (54, 54 and 9 slots). Equip in a Curios belt slot when not in use.
Sneak-use a block to attune this ring while empty, then equip it in a Curios ring slot. It absorbs matching inventory blocks up to 2,147,483,647 while retaining and refilling one ordinary stack for building. Use a surface to place a stored block; sneak-use in the air to withdraw a stack. Blocks with custom components are not absorbed.
en_us.research.thaumictinkerer.placement_mirro: Sneak-use a block to select it. Sneak-use in the air cycles the square size from 3 to 11. Use a surface to build a plane along its face, consuming blocks from your inventory or Black Hole Rings. Block placement respects world borders and placement cancellation.
en_us.research.thaumictinkerer.protoclay.title: Protoclay
en_us.research.thaumictinkerer.protoclay.text:
You grew tired of having to constantly swap your tools.

This mixture will, by melding with the Ichorium, switch any Awakened Ichorium tools being held by the one used for the block being pointed at, case one tries to break it with the wrong tool.

As an example, trying to break a dirt block with an Awakened Ichorium Pickaxe while a Shovel is present elsewhere in the inventory will swap the two, and allow for fast disposal of the dirt block.
en_us.research.thaumictinkerer.warp_gate.title: Celestial Gateway
en_us.research.thaumictinkerer.warp_gate.text: Use an unattuned Celestial Pearl on a gateway to bind it. Sneak-use a bound pearl on another gateway to insert a destination (10 slots). Sneak-use an empty hand to cycle destination, then use to teleport. Sneak-use redstone to lock arrivals; sneak-use a pearl in the air to clear its attunement. Destinations must be in the same dimension and have clear space. Breaking a gateway drops its pearls.
en_us.message.thaumictinkerer.gate_unavailable: Destination unavailable: missing pearl or gateway, locked arrivals, or obstructed space.

zh_cn.research.thaumictinkerer.ichor_cap.title: 灵宝杖端
zh_cn.research.thaumictinkerer.ichor_cap.text: 你将灵宝锭投入了它的第一项应用,用于设计一支能够减免各种魔力消耗20%的杖端.现在你能拿这玩意儿做出一堆能够储存更多魔力的法杖了.
干得漂亮.用灵布对银树杖芯注魔,你设法制造出了一支终极杖柄.

这支杖柄对各种魔力的容量都高达1000点.用于加工各种昂贵的奥术材料都绰绰有余,毫无压力.现在摆在你面前的问题反而是,上哪弄那么多魔力充满它呢?
zh_cn.research.thaumictinkerer.ichorcloth_armo:
你研究出如何将灵布编织成衣服.

这些新织就的服饰皆具有凡俗钻石套抵御伤害之效用.不仅如此,这套衣服没有耐久一说,永远都不会刮擦磨损.
你研究出一种方法,能够改造灵布头巾,让它变得更加强大.

首先,它兼具揭示之护目镜的法用.
其次,穿戴者将会获得水下呼吸的能力,水下视野也将如水晶般澄澈.
最后,戴上这顶头巾的人会发现即使饿着肚子,生命值也依旧会自动回复,就像不戴头巾但饱腹度却满着时那样.按U可关闭护甲特殊效果.
zh_cn.research.thaumictinkerer.ichor_chest_gem:
你研究出一种方法,能够改造灵布法袍,让它变得更加强大.

首先,穿戴上这种法袍会受到飞行能量的护佑,背后生长出燃烧的羽翼,能够让你在短时间内(5分钟内)飞上天任意遨游,并且无视掉落伤害.
不仅如此,类似扭曲法杖核心的威能,穿戴这件法袍后还能抵御箭矢火球等抛射物的袭击.按U可关闭护甲特殊效果.
你研究出一种方法,能够改造灵布护腿,让它变得更加强大.

这种护腿被灌入了灵魂的烈焰。
首先,它能散发出亮度犹胜超能闪耀之光的光芒,不但能让穿戴者犹如手持着电筒般视野开阔,还能让他犹如暗夜里的萤火虫般广受瞩目.
其次,这种护腿不但能抵御火焰伤害,还能将其转换为治愈效果.按U可关闭护甲特殊效果.
zh_cn.research.thaumictinkerer.ichor_boots_gem:
你研究出一种方法,能够改造灵布靴子,让它变得更加强大.

类似旅行者之靴，这双靴子也能赋予穿戴者卓绝顺畅的运动能力,让穿戴者更更快,更更高,更更远,让运动变得犹如微风迎面般容易.穿戴者将能直接跨过一格高的台阶,除非处于潜行状态.
穿戴后还自带获得急迫II的buff效果,并且会让走过的泥土发芽变成草地,无视一切掉落伤害.按U可关闭护甲特殊效果.
zh_cn.research.thaumictinkerer.ichor_tools.tex:
你发现了如何利用灵宝制作工具.这些工具非常强大,比钻石做的还了不起,更了不起的是,还不用坏.

要制作这样了不起的工具,木棍当手柄就不太合适了,你决定换成银树杖芯来代替.
你唤醒了灵宝镐真正的力量.这柄镐子不仅将保留沉睡状态下具有的一应能力,还获得了模式切换功能,只需要按住shift右击即可.

在方块模式(绿色)下它按正常方式挖掘.

在正方模式(红色)下它会一次挖出5x5的区域,为方便故,该区域位置会相对挖掘起始位置有所偏移.

在线型模式(蓝色)下
zh_cn.research.thaumictinkerer.ichor_shovel_ge:
你唤醒了灵宝铲真正的力量.这柄铲子不仅将保留沉睡状态下具有的一应能力,还获得了模式切换功能,只需要按住shift右击即可.

在方块模式(绿色)下它按正常方式挖掘.

在正方模式(红色)下它会在起始方块周围一次挖出5x5的区域.

在柱型模式(蓝色)下它会呈柱形在上下各8格的范围内挖掘与起始方块同类型的方块.
zh_cn.research.thaumictinkerer.ichor_axe_gem.t:
你唤醒了灵宝斧真正的力量.这柄斧头不仅将保留沉睡状态下具有的一应能力,还获得了模式切换功能,只需要按住shift右击即可.

在方块模式(绿色)下它按正常方式伐木.

在正方模式(红色)下它能同时伐掉起始木材周围的方块.

在伐木模式(蓝色)下它能伐掉起始木材所在的整棵树.

此外,这柄斧头也非常适合用来收割植物的生命.
zh_cn.research.thaumictinkerer.ichor_sword_gem:
你唤醒了灵宝剑真正的力量.这柄剑不仅将保留沉睡状态下具有的一应能力,还获得了模式切换功能,只需要按住shift右击即可.

在单杀模式(绿色)下它按正常方式进行攻击.

在区域模式(红色)下它将会伤害到被击中目标三格范围的所有生物.

在狩魂模式(蓝色)下它的威力将会略微减小,但每一击都能使得持剑者增加一颗魂心. 
[下页]
zh_cn.research.thaumictinkerer.cat_amulet.text:
没费多久功夫,你就想出法子让那些你憎恶的爬行者再也无法近身.

最终,利用爬行者畏惧猫的知识,你设计出了一枚能让爬行者避之如虎的护身符.不仅如此,这些可怜的家伙吓得发愣,都聚集不起火力自爆了.赞耶!装备在项链栏才有效.
zh_cn.research.thaumictinkerer.ichor_pouch.tex: 可容纳普通物品的 117 格无底袋，禁止嵌套存放。使用打开当前页，潜行使用依次切换三页（54、54、9 格）。平时可装备在 Curios 腰带栏。
空戒指潜行使用方块即可绑定，装备在 Curios 戒指栏后自动吸收背包中同类方块，最多存放 2,147,483,647 个，并保留、补满一组供普通建造使用。对表面使用放置一块；潜行对空使用取出一组。不会吸收带自定义组件的方块。
zh_cn.research.thaumictinkerer.placement_mirro: 潜行使用方块以选择材料；潜行对空使用可将边长在 3 至 11 之间切换。对表面使用可沿该面建造平面，消耗背包或黑洞戒指中的方块，遵守世界边界和放置事件。
zh_cn.research.thaumictinkerer.protoclay.title: 息壤
zh_cn.research.thaumictinkerer.protoclay.text:
你厌倦了总是要轮换工具的日子.

这团混有灵宝的物质,能够在你使用错误工具进行操作时自动将手持工具切换为合适的觉醒灵宝工具.

例如,一旦你试图用觉醒灵宝镐挖土,而物品栏里却有觉醒灵宝铲时,手持工具会马上自动替换成觉醒灵宝铲,以便让你更快速地挖下泥土.
zh_cn.research.thaumictinkerer.warp_gate.title: 仙域之门
zh_cn.research.thaumictinkerer.warp_gate.text: 对天体网关使用未绑定的天体珍珠以绑定位置。潜行使用已绑定珍珠插入另一网关（10 个目的地栏位）。空手潜行使用切换目的地，普通使用传送；持红石潜行使用切换到达锁。潜行对空使用珍珠清除绑定。目的地必须处于同一维度且上方空间畅通；破坏网关会掉落珍珠。
zh_cn.message.thaumictinkerer.gate_unavailable: 无法到达：珍珠为空、网关锁定或目的地空间阻塞。
